title: Name the surfaces a pre-reader has to cross
ask: S-7 says phase 1's core loop needs no reading, but nothing lists which surfaces that covers. Walk the farming loop — clear, till, plant, water, sleep, harvest, buy seeds — and name every surface a player crosses to do it. That list turns an untested promise into a check, and it also settles the scope argument in the open robot-menu question: whether a machine panel is inside the loop or outside it.
first_action: Play the loop on the tablet build and write down every panel it passes through.
